recognize_zh: 紅血球明顯大小不一與異形，可見多顆淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocytes）與橢圓形紅血球，中央另有一大型血小板/血小板團，符合骨髓纖維化的周邊血象。
features: Numerous teardrop cells (dacrocytes) with single tapered tails
Large platelet or platelet aggregate in the center; small platelets scattered
No leukocytes or nucleated red cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells, ovalocytes and occasional irregular poikilocytes. A giant platelet or platelet aggregate is present centrally. No white cells or nucleated red cells are included in this field, so a leukoerythroblastic picture cannot be assessed here. Findings are consistent with the peripheral blood changes of primary myelofibrosis, although dacrocytes are not specific for it.

ddx.vs: Dacrocytes and leukoerythroblastosis also occur with marrow infiltration; marrow biopsy showing metastatic tumor or granulomas and absence of JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation separate it.
Smear findings are identical; a documented prior history of PV or ET distinguishes secondary myelofibrosis.
These may show teardrops but have microcytosis with target cells or macro-ovalocytes with hypersegmented neutrophils, respectively.
Artifactual teardrops have tails pointing in the same direction across the field, whereas true dacrocytes point randomly.
